_evidence: Car block at esi for 0x0040efa2 (overlay after car_004129fa+rec_0040e9ac+rec_0040ee7b): 'cmp dword [esi+0xc0],0xc0000000; jne' selects the first-timing path (+0xc0 is the 0xc0000000 'no previous time' sentinel, as in 0x40f02e), so the sentinel is drawn in about a third of the cases and otherwise a previous clock value (any); the elapsed time [0x66d814]-ebx-[+0xc0] is stored, never used as an address. Byte +0x7c is the car number passed on to 0x40f06c, which stores at ((b & 0x3f) - 1) with only an upper clamp: low bits 0 would write onto the order list 0x675958 itself and hang the 0x52286e bubble sort, and no car has number 0, so the domain is rec_0040f06c's (1..22 with flag bits, 23/63 for the clamp).
